questions.stem: Listen carefully. Which did you hear?

questions.stem: Listen carefully. Which place did you hear?

questions.stem: Listen carefully. Which word did you hear?
questions.explanation: You heard 「ひゃく」 (hyaku), one hundred: ひゃ is one blended sound made with a small ゃ. With a full-sized や it becomes two sounds, ひ and や.
